tasks.label: Fairbeam: Restart serve
tasks.command: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='python.exe'" | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'fairbeam serve|fairbeam\.preview worker' } | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; $env:OPENEMS_INSTALL_PATH = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\org.fairbeam.desktop\runtime\openEMS"; $env:PYTHONPATH = "${workspaceFolder}\python"; Set-Location "${workspaceFolder}\python"; & "${workspaceFolder}\.venv\Scripts\python.exe" -m fairbeam serve
